persona.name: Alex Chen

formatting_preferences: Bullet lists only for action items

global_learned_rules: Never use 'I hope this email finds you well'
Lead with the ask or decision needed
Keep technical details to one paragraph max
Use 'ship date' not 'deadline' for external comms

learned_rules_json: Casual tone okay - we've shipped 3 projects together
Can reference internal shorthand like 'the usual Friday deploy'
Keep it formal - procurement CCs everything
Always include PO number in subject when applicable
Never use casual greetings - board members may be BCC'd
Reference HIPAA compliance context when relevant
Friday 4pm standup is our sync anchor - can mention casually
Strict formal register - government audit trail
Direct and concise - she prefers bullets over paragraphs
Can use casual shorthand like 'Model v3' and 'staging cluster'
Partner context - CC legal on contractual matters
Casual creative collab tone - slightly more relaxed
Visual references welcome (Figma links, Loom videos)

historical_emails.subject: Re: Ollama serve config - CUDA OOM fix
historical_emails.clean_body:
Hey Sam,

Fixed the CUDA host buffer OOM during parallel inference. Use OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1, OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1, OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=4096, and OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1.

Kill the stale worker process first, then restart the daemon and rerun your load test.

Best,
Alex
